status_policy.PLANNED: Case definition exists; no solver evidence yet.
status_policy.READY: Infrastructure/capability is sufficient to execute; no quantitative PASS implied.
status_policy.DIAGNOSTIC: Executable exists but quantitative/convergence evidence is not yet acceptable.
status_policy.PASS: Actual CFDX solver execution, conservation, quantitative QoI agreement and reproducible evidence are all present.
status_policy.BLOCKED: Required capability or trustworthy reference configuration is absent.

cases.reference: Exact Couette solution; CFDX solver validation history and PR #420/related validation records
cases.parameters: U_wall=1; H=1; Re based on H and U
cases.mesh: N=32,64 minimum; structured orthogonal meshes; refinement ratio 2
cases.boundary_conditions: Moving no-slip wall; stationary wall; pressure reference as required
cases.numerical_schemes: Finite volume; bounded convection; gradient/face interpolation recorded explicitly
cases.solver_settings: SIMPLE baseline; relaxation values recorded; linear tolerances recorded
cases.conservation_criteria: Continuity L_inf and normalized continuity reported; global mass imbalance bounded
cases.qoi: u(y), mean velocity, max profile error
cases.error: L_inf and mean relative error per mesh
cases.observed_order: Computed from at least three meshes; p_obs reported
cases.runtime: Wall-clock per mesh and total campaign
cases.regression_status: Required CI regression; no tolerance inflation

cases.parameters: Canonical pressure-driven pipe/channel case; dimensional inputs stored with case
cases.boundary_conditions: No-slip walls; pressure/flow driving condition; outlet/reference pressure
cases.numerical_schemes: Finite volume; scheme and gradient reconstruction recorded
cases.conservation_criteria: Mass balance and integrated flux mismatch
cases.qoi: Velocity profile, flow rate, pressure drop
cases.reference_value: Q_h=1/6+h^2/3 for the established manufactured/analytical setup; continuum limit 1/6

cases.parameters: Re=100 baseline; extension to Re=400 and 1000 after baseline is stable
cases.mesh: At least 32,64,128,256 equivalent refinement; uniform or documented graded mesh
cases.boundary_conditions: Moving top lid U=1; other walls no-slip; pressure gauge
cases.numerical_schemes: Compare bounded upwind baseline and higher-order schemes once stable
cases.convergence_criteria: Residual + velocity QoI stabilization; no fixed-iteration PASS
cases.conservation_criteria: Global mass imbalance and divergence norms
cases.qoi: u centerline, v centerline, vortex locations/strengths
cases.regression_status: Must remain active; current stagnation is diagnostic, not PASS

cases.reference: Roache (1998) verification methodology; exact manufactured field with source terms
cases.parameters: Smooth analytic velocity/pressure/scalar fields; source terms derived symbolically
cases.mesh: At least 3 systematically refined meshes; r≈2
cases.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet values taken from manufactured solution; source terms exact
cases.numerical_schemes: Run each supported spatial order separately
cases.solver_settings: Linear/nonlinear errors at least one order below discretization error
cases.convergence_criteria: Iterative error negligible relative to discretization error
cases.conservation_criteria: Integrated PDE/source balance and local residual norms
cases.qoi: L2/Linf field errors and residual/source balance
cases.regression_status: CI; fail if observed order or conservation contract is violated

cases.reference: Tabata & Itakura literature datum as documented in VMFL036; implemented physical case in PR #441
cases.mesh: Coarse/medium/fine body-fitted 3-D or axisymmetric configuration matching the declared reference geometry
cases.boundary_conditions: Sphere no-slip; inlet U; farfield; outlet pressure/zero-gradient as documented
cases.numerical_schemes: SIMPLE baseline; bounded convection; traction integration independent of solver force
cases.solver_settings: Explicit nonlinear/linear tolerances; pressure reference; relaxation
cases.conservation_criteria: Continuity and momentum residuals; domain mass balance
cases.qoi: Pressure drag, viscous drag, total Cd
cases.reference_value: Cd=1.0895; F=0.4278456495 N as literature oracle
cases.error: Relative Cd error after mesh-converged setup
cases.regression_status: Depends on #441; no literature PASS until mesh/domain equivalence is demonstrated

cases.reference: Ladson (1988) experimental NACA 0012 data; angles of attack and Reynolds/Mach explicitly frozen per case
cases.parameters: Chord=1; Re and Mach fixed per subcase; alpha sweep
cases.mesh: C-grid/O-grid; boundary-distance and y+ documented; 3+ refinements
cases.numerical_schemes: Pressure-velocity coupling + convection/gradient scheme explicitly recorded
cases.solver_settings: Steady RANS baseline once turbulence model is qualified; laminar subcase first
cases.conservation_criteria: Mass flux imbalance; farfield flux balance
cases.qoi: CL, CD, Cm and pressure coefficient distribution
cases.reference_value: Experimental polar / Cp data for selected alpha, Re, Mach
cases.error: Relative force error and Cp norm
cases.regression_status: Future quantitative validation; no PASS from capability existence

cases.reference: Fully developed plane-channel analytical solution for laminar baseline
cases.parameters: Re based on bulk velocity and hydraulic/half height; fixed canonical value
cases.boundary_conditions: No-slip walls; periodic or pressure-gradient driving
cases.conservation_criteria: Inlet/outlet mass balance or periodic flux balance

cases.reference_value: Analytical laminar channel profile and friction relation

cases.parameters: Canonical 2-D geometry; selected Re from the experimental range; primary target Re fixed before PASS
